recorded.prompt:q-service:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-service:a: "The time callback feeds the Time dimension only. The arc cost stays the drive minutes ... adding it to the objective would change nothing but the number."
recorded.prompt:q-service:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-service:c: Slack is waiting, "an extra amount the vehicle may add", which is optional. The page puts service in the transit: "the inspection at a, then the drive".
recorded.prompt:q-service:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-service:d: "Forget the service time and the plan is wrong". In the replay, crew 1 missed A064 and A302's windows.
recorded.prompt:q-arrival-range:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-arrival-range:a: The two times bound the arrival ("arrival range"). They are not the start and end of the work on site.
recorded.prompt:q-arrival-range:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-arrival-range:b: Any arrival in the range is feasible, and "the earliest time is the schedule". The range "lies inside the stop's own window" and need not be its close.
recorded.prompt:q-arrival-range:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-arrival-range:d: "the range is the room the crew has if something runs late". It is room to wait, not a wait the solver chose.
recorded.prompt:q-objective-time:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-objective-time:b: The objective "is the arc cost: the sum of travel times". The extra minutes come from waiting, not dropped-visit penalties.
recorded.prompt:q-objective-time:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-objective-time:c: The page explains the difference as waiting ("also counts waiting"), not rounding.
recorded.prompt:q-objective-time:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-objective-time:d: The finalizer "pick[s] the smallest feasible value" for the start and end cumuls, so each crew returns as early as its route allows.
